purpose: future expanded-validation paths defined without any experiment; assessed on the five registered criteria only

frozenContext.step32: PARTIAL (3 of 8 windows evaluable; 10 of 32 drifters; Phase A minimum 6 windows / 20 drifters NOT MET)
frozenContext.step33: SOURCE_ABSENT (0 of 5 blocked windows recoverable from the registered source)
frozenContext.hycomCoverage: expt_53.X 1994-01..2015-12 with documented gaps (2010-08-18T12Z; 2011-06-09T12Z, 06-15T00Z, 06-20T12Z, 06-22T12Z, 06-26T18Z); no gap inventory exists for other periods yet
frozenContext.excludedDrifterIdsForAnyNewCohort: STEP 20 calibration (23) + STEP 20 holdout (13, incl. KE-H2) + all 32 STEP 32 registered IDs (evaluable and blocked)
frozenContext.excludedWindowStarts: STEP 20 calibration/holdout starts and all 8 STEP 32 window starts (+-72 h)

A.name: Same HYCOM source, different preregistered observation period
conditions: observation period fixed and locked before any availability check
HYCOM frame inventory (NCSS time-axis metadata) checked for the fixed period before cohort selection
cohort selected only after availability is established (STEP 16 eligibility + STEP 32 disjointness rules)

scientificObjective.assessment: addresses the same registered questions (temporal representation; candidate vs baseline) on new windows

sourceCompleteness.assessment: depends on a period-specific frame inventory; the 2011 gaps show that completeness must be verified frame by frame before the period is locked

temporalCoverage.assessment: complete only where every UTC day of every window has 8 frames; verified per candidate day

independence.assessment: new period, new drifters, disjoint from all prior cohorts; same product family as the baseline

preregistrationFeasibility.assessment: feasible: period lock -> inventory -> cohort derivation -> lock, all calendar/data based

B.name: Same source family, separate preregistered cohort with complete temporal coverage
conditions: cohort selection rule preregistered (STEP 16 eligibility verbatim + disjointness from every prior cohort + frame-inventory gate as an eligibility criterion)
cohort never changed after results are seen

scientificObjective.assessment: same registered questions; the frame-inventory gate becomes part of eligibility so that no selected window can be source-blocked

sourceCompleteness.assessment: highest: completeness is a preregistered selection criterion, not a post-hoc discovery

temporalCoverage.assessment: 48-frame requirement satisfied by construction for every selected window

independence.assessment: disjoint IDs and windows; regions may extend to the other STEP 16 boxes (GS, BM) subject to the same rules

preregistrationFeasibility.assessment: feasible: reuses derive_step32_holdout.py logic plus an availability inventory input (calendar/data only)

C.name: Keep the 2011 cohort; preserve the 3-window / 10-drifter result as descriptive evidence only

scientificObjective.assessment: does not answer the expanded-validation question at the registered minimum

independence.assessment: already independent of calibration and historical holdout

preregistrationFeasibility.assessment: already preregistered and executed; nothing further to register

D.name: Separate independent validation dataset
conditions: no mixing with the STEP 32 holdout

scientificObjective.assessment: answers generalization beyond the current observation family only if the dataset carries comparable drifter-type / drogue information

sourceCompleteness.assessment: unknown until the source and its frame inventory are registered

independence.assessment: highest nominal independence; comparability of observation type must be established first

preregistrationFeasibility.assessment: feasible only after a new data-source preregistration (identity, licence, acquisition, quality gate)

selectionRule.rule: no option is chosen on any STEP 32 performance result; the criteria-based assessment above is the only basis
selectionRule.criteriaBasedRecommendation: B (preregistered new cohort within the same source family with a frame-inventory gate inside the eligibility rule; Option A is its period-locking mechanism), with C retained as the permanent descriptive record of the 2011 cohort; D only if B cannot reach the minimum within HYCOM expt_53.X coverage
prohibited: replacing any of the 5 blocked windows with another source
adding drifters to the existing holdout
reporting the 3-window result as meeting the minimum
choosing period, cohort or option from performance
